raw_description_html:
Slow down, one warm stroke at a time.

A silky massage and body oil enriched with vitamin E and blended with essential oils for a calming, aromatic massage. Smooth it on after your bath or shower, or share an evening massage, and let your skin soak it in.

Why you'll love it

  • Smooth, easy glide for self-massage or a partner massage
  • Leaves skin feeling soft, smooth and nourished
  • A soothing essential-oil aroma for unwinding at the end of the day
  • Every batch is GC/MS tested for quality

How to use

Warm a little oil between your palms and massage into clean skin with long, slow strokes. Use it as a body oil after bathing, or for massage.

Size

8 fl oz (240 ml)

For external use only. Patch test before first use and avoid contact with eyes. Keep out of reach of children and pets. Discontinue use if irritation occurs.
